base_prompt: Turkish alternative pop, intimate live studio band, instrumental only. Warm acoustic guitar, expressive piano, melodic electric bass, real drum kit, restrained clean electric guitar. Cohesive memorable recurring two-bar lead motif, human microtiming and touch, breathing room for a future singer. No EDM drop, no genre switch, no dense synth layers, no vocals or speech. Key B minor, 102 BPM, 4/4. Lead motif: The chorus hook centers on a descending motif across scale degrees 5-3-2-1 in B minor (F#-D-C#-B). It strikes an accented F#4 on beat 1 on 'Yelkovan', falls across eighth-note syncopation on 'zaman durur' (D4 to C#4), and settles onto B3 with an airy chest-voice resonance on 'burada'. A subtle upper auxiliary flick (B3-C#4-B3) on 'yeşil çuhada' gives the second phrase an immediate, melancholic lilt..

timeline.name: intro
timeline.arrangement: Gentle steel-string acoustic guitar picks the syncopated root motif, paired with a soft felt upright piano chord pad. Muted room ambiance with low-volume mechanical clock ticks tucked into the stereo field.

timeline.name: verse_1
timeline.arrangement: Upright bass enters with warm, rounded root-fifth movement. Subtle wooden rim-clicks mark beat three alongside dry acoustic guitar arpeggios, leaving vocal space wide and dry.

timeline.name: pre_1
timeline.arrangement: A soft brushed snare rolls in; reversed piano swells create harmonic tension as the bass walks stepwise from E to A beneath the climbing pre-chorus lines.

timeline.name: chorus_1
timeline.arrangement: Full rhythm section enters with punchy, dampened kick and brushed snare. Open acoustic strumming wide in the stereo image supports a melodic electric guitar answering line after each vocal phrase.

timeline.name: turnaround
timeline.arrangement: Acoustic guitar and bass strip back down to a four-bar breath. Clean electric guitar plays a single-note echo of the main hook with tasteful analog delay.

timeline.name: verse_2
timeline.arrangement: Light sixteenth-note shaker layered with wooden rim-clicks. Bass plays a more syncopated counter-rhythm against muted electric guitar stabs on upbeats.

timeline.name: pre_2
timeline.arrangement: Dynamic build with crescendoing floor tom patterns, doubled acoustic strums, and expressive bass glides pushing into the second chorus entry.

timeline.name: chorus_2
timeline.arrangement: Full instrumentation with prominent electric counter-melody, doubled acoustic guitars, driving bass line, and crisp drum fills reinforcing chorus recall.

timeline.name: bridge
timeline.arrangement: Sudden drop to near-silence. Sustained piano chords modulate briefly with ambient guitar volume swells and sub-bass resonance, leaving the introspective vocal completely exposed.

timeline.name: final_chorus
timeline.arrangement: Climactic dynamic peak with layered backing hums, ringing open-string guitars, rhythmic drum accents, and soaring top-end electric lead fills before a sudden half-time cadence.

timeline.name: outro
timeline.arrangement: Drums cut out; fingerpicked acoustic guitar repeats the opening progression alongside slow-decaying piano notes, concluding on an unresolved Bmadd9 with soft ticking fading into silence.
